_README: Working examples of the recommended hooks. Copy the blocks you want into
.claude/settings.json, substitute the project's real commands, and DELETE the rest.
A settings file full of unused hooks is one nobody edits confidently.
Every PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook runs on EVERY matching tool call, so keep them fast.
Test each hook by triggering it before declaring it done — a silently failing hook is
worse than no hook, because you now believe you're protected.
Remove this _README key from the real settings file.

PostToolUse._comment: Format on write. Swap the formatter for the project's own: ruff format / gofmt / rustfmt / etc.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.md) npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.py) ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

PostToolUse._comment: Typecheck TypeScript after edits. Drop this if the project isn't TS or tsc is slow.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx --no-install tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30 ;; esac

PreToolUse._comment: Guard genuinely unrecoverable commands. Keep the list SHORT and specific — a guard that fires on safe commands gets disabled within a week.

hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'rm[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*[rf][a-zA-Z]*[[:space:]]+(/|~|\$HOME)([[:space:]]|$)|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+.*--force([[:space:]]+|=).*(main|master)|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+--force[[:space:]]+origin[[:space:]]+(main|master)|git[[:space:]]+clean[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*d|DROP[[:space:]]+DATABASE|mkfs\.'; then echo 'BLOCKED by PreToolUse hook: destructive command. Run it manually if you are certain.' >&2; exit 2; fi

PreToolUse._comment: Block commits that would leak secrets. Strongly recommended for anything with paid API keys.

hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env$'; then echo 'BLOCKED: .env is staged. Unstage it before committing.' >&2; exit 2; fi; if git diff --cached -U0 | grep -qE '^\+.*(sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}|sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}|AIza[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16})'; then echo 'BLOCKED: staged diff looks like it contains an API key.' >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac

SessionStart._comment: Print where the project is, so picking it up after two weeks away isn't archaeology.

hooks.command: echo "branch: $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'not a repo')"; git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -10; if [ -f docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md ]; then echo; sed -n '/## What.s next/,/^## /p' docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md | head -12; fi

Stop._comment: Run tests when Claude finishes. ONLY add this if the suite is fast — it delays every single response.

PreCompact._comment: Snapshot the transcript before it's compacted. Useful for long sessions and the retro agent.

hooks.command: d=.claude/transcripts; mkdir -p "$d"; t=$(jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); [ -n "$t" ] && [ -f "$t" ] && cp "$t" "$d/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).jsonl" || true

SessionEnd._comment: Append a line to a local session log. Low value alone; pairs with the retro agent.

hooks.command: mkdir -p .claude && echo "$(date -Iseconds) session ended on $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" >> .claude/session.log
